rows.commentary: 0.1: Naseem Shah hurls it full and wide, drawing a thick edge off Lahiru Udara's drive that races down to third man for a single.
0.2: Naseem Shah strays violently down the leg-side, offering five wides as the delivery sails completely past Kusal Mendis and leaves the wicketkeeper stranded.
0.2: Naseem Shah compounds his radar issues with an off-side wide as Shadab strides in to have a quiet word with his struggling fast bowler.
0.2: Naseem Shah drifts a half-volley onto the pads, flicked aerially toward deep backward square leg where the fielder collects it cleanly on the bounce.
0.3: Naseem Shah offers width with a swinging full delivery, comfortably driven by Lahiru Udara straight to the mid-off fielder.
0.4: Naseem Shah targets middle from a back of a length, allowing Lahiru Udara to tuck it neatly into the gap wide of mid-on for a run.
0.5: Naseem Shah lures Kusal Mendis into a wide drive, extracting a healthy edge that flies straight into the waiting hands of debutant Mohammad Imran Randhawa at third man.
0.6: Naseem Shah spears a full delivery just outside off stump, beating Kamil Mishara's ambitious drive off the toe-end safely through to the wicketkeeper.
1.1: Mohammad Imran Randhawa fires it full and swinging inward, allowing Lahiru Udara to clip it deftly behind square for a single.
1.2: Mohammad Imran Randhawa fires it back of a length and angled away from off, prompting Kamil Mishara to softly angle the face and direct it straight to backward point.
1.3: Mohammad Imran Randhawa draws Kamil Mishara into a rash cut outside off, the away-swing leaving the batter grasping at thin air.
1.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa repeats the exact dose on the fifth stump line, leaving Kamil Mishara defeated by the movement once more.
1.5: Kamil Mishara does not score off Mohammad Imran Randhawa.
1.6: Mohammad Imran Randhawa fires it back of a length across off, and Kamil Mishara punches it crisply straight into the hands of cover.
2.1: Naseem Shah targets a back-of-a-length line into middle and leg, nipping away to catch the splice of Lahiru Udara's bat and loop safely just short of mid-on for a single.
2.2: Naseem Shah keeps the pressure mounting, pinning down Kamil Mishara as the dot balls accumulate.

2.3: Naseem Shah lands it back of a length on middle and forces the ball to jag sharply back in, catching Mishara's inside edge and thudding into the thigh pad to compound eight consecutive dot balls.
2.4: Naseem Shah delivers back of a length, and Kamil Mishara finally breaks his duck after nine scoreless balls by pulling it over midwicket for four.
2.5: Naseem Shah spears this fuller delivery wide of the off stump, tempting Kamil Mishara into a drive that picks out the congested cordon.
2.6: Naseem Shah pins him on a hard length at the leg stump, suffocating the space as Kamil Mishara punches it firmly wide of mid-on.

3.1: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drops it full and angles it away from off, inducing a fierce heave across the line from Kamil Mishara that cannons off a thick edge down to deep backward point for a single.
3.2: Mohammad Imran Randhawa slides it through to Lahiru Udara, who misjudges the pull and mistimes the stroke off the inner half straight on the bounce to mid-on for a single.
3.3: Mohammad Imran Randhawa draws the mistimed pull from Kamil Mishara, sending the ball towering into the twilight before Fakhar Zaman settles underneath it to complete a straightforward dismissal.
3.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drifts this short delivery steeply down the leg side, prompting the umpire to stretch his arms wide.
3.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa fires one in that swings away sharply outside the off stump, leaving Kamindu Mendis to watch it sail through to the keeper without offering a shot.
3.5: Mohammad Imran Randhawa offers width outside off, and Kamindu Mendis rises tall to punch it crisply through point for four.
3.6: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drops short of a length, safely guided away by Kamindu Mendis to deep backward point for a single.
4.1: Razaullah targets a good length outside off, drawing Kamindu Mendis into a flashy drive on the up that zips past the outside edge untouched.
4.2: Razaullah charges in again, and Kamindu Mendis nudges this delivery square of the wicket to rotate the strike.
4.3: Razaullah drifts this one through, and Lahiru Udara lofts it powerfully down the ground, racing away to the long-off boundary.
4.4: Razaullah bowls a wide to Lahiru Udara.
4.4: Razaullah serves it full just outside off, and Lahiru Udara lets it pass safely through.
4.5: Razaullah delivers to Lahiru Udara who swings hard down the ground but fails to find the timing, leaving it scoreless.
4.6: Razaullah feeds width, and Lahiru Udara clears a path, exploiting the swing to loft it cleanly over point for four.
5.1: No run for Kamindu Mendis off Mohammad Imran Randhawa.
5.2: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drops the pace onto a length, coaxed away by Kamindu Mendis with a soft push toward mid-off for a single.
5.3: Mohammad Imran Randhawa hunts the toes with a sharp yorker, tying up Lahiru Udara as he carves a frantic inside edge away behind square for a single.
5.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa hurls it length and away outside off, catching Kamindu Mendis slashing in a big slog before a fortunate top edge flies over short third for four.
5.5: Mohammad Imran Randhawa delivers to Kamindu Mendis, who dispatches it square of the wicket for another boundary.
5.6: Mohammad Imran Randhawa hits a back of a length trajectory into the leg side, allowing Kamindu Mendis to scamper through for a single.
6.1: Abrar Ahmed darts it into Kamindu Mendis, who quietly pushes the ball toward long-off to pick up a single.
6.2: Abrar Ahmed darts a flat length ball into the off stump, and Lahiru Udara swats a heavy, mistimed pull cascading away toward the long-on boundary for a single.
6.3: No run for Kamindu Mendis off Abrar Ahmed.
6.4: Kamindu Mendis skips down the track to Abrar Ahmed, failing to reach the pitch of the googly but quietly nudging it down to long-on for a single.
6.5: Lahiru Udara works Abrar Ahmed out towards long-on, scampering back sharply to pick up a comfortable couple of runs.
6.6: Abrar Ahmed darts a flat leg-break outside off to Lahiru Udara, who pulls it off the inner half through midwicket to scamper back for a sharp couple.
7.1: Shadab Khan tosses it up at the timber, prompting Kamindu Mendis to skip down the track and whip it firmly toward long-on for a single.
7.2: Shadab Khan loops it slow into the stumps, and Lahiru Udara immediately clears his front leg to carve an inside-out drive soaring over extra cover for four.
7.3: Shadab Khan drifts a googly just outside the off stump, which Lahiru Udara carves through point to comfortably hustle back for a second run.
7.4: Shadab Khan loops this one up outside off and Lahiru Udara punishes it with a crisp sweep through the ring for four.
7.5: Shadab Khan offers another overpitched delivery, and Lahiru Udara smashes it wide of long-on, racing back frantically for a well-earned second run.
7.6: Shadab Khan drops it in once more, and Lahiru Udara works it away smoothly toward mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
8.1: Abrar Ahmed drifts one in on a length, the batsman opening the blade to nudge it towards point before an aborted dash for a single is wisely aborted.
8.2: Abrar Ahmed floats it through, pushed firmly down the ground toward long-on for a brisk single.
8.3: Abrar Ahmed flights this one invitingly, forcing Kamindu Mendis to charge down the track, smother the turn, and gently bunt the ball right back into the turf before the bowler.
8.4: Abrar Ahmed offers up an egregious full toss that Kamindu Mendis ruthlessly dispatches by pivoting into a reverse sweep, carving it fiercely past backward point to the boundary.
8.5: Abrar Ahmed drops the googly into the leg-strip, and Kamindu Mendis skips down the pitch to turn it cleanly through midwicket for a single.
8.6: Abrar Ahmed fires a flat length delivery just outside the off stump, safely nudged away for one.
9.1: Saim Ayub floats one drifting into the pads, allowing Lahiru Udara to work it away neatly for a couple of runs.
9.2: Saim Ayub offers a slow length delivery angled into the pads, and Lahiru Udara wrists it away into the deep for an easy pair of runs.
9.3: Saim Ayub floats another one up, and Lahiru Udara works it away smoothly to deep mid-wicket to rotate the strike.
9.4: Saim Ayub lures Kamindu Mendis into the trap as Fakhar Zaman pouches the catch to end a brisk twenty-three.
9.5: Saim Ayub tosses this one up, and Sahan Arachchige drives it down to long-on for a single.
9.6: Saim Ayub strays down the line, and Lahiru Udara capitalizes by smiting it away to fine leg for four.
10.1: Mohammad Imran Randhawa strikes as Sahan Arachchige falls for one, sharp-eyed Shadab Khan safely gathering the chance at backward point.
10.2: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drifts one into the pads and Dasun Shanaka works it away neatly behind square for a single.
10.3: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drops the inswinger down leg, catching Lahiru Udara high on the thigh pad as he wildly across-the-line swings, scampering a leg bye square.
10.4: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drops it back of a length into the channel, catching Dasun Shanaka high on the thigh pad as the inswinger darts through for a leg bye.
10.5: Mohammad Imran Randhawa fires a length delivery swinging sharply inward, allowing Lahiru Udara to flick it towards midwicket and scamper through for a brisk single.
10.6: Mohammad Imran Randhawa drops the inswinger onto off stump, and Dasun Shanaka retreats to push it firmly back to the bowler, capping off an extraordinary debut for the twenty-nine-year-old.
11.1: Saim Ayub tosses it up, Lahiru Udara switches stance in a flash, and violently slaps the reverse sweep behind backward point to race away to the fence.
11.2: Saim Ayub floats it into the pads, and Lahiru Udara retreats deep into his crease to clip a single through midwicket that brings him to forty-nine.
11.3: Saim Ayub drops another on a good length targeting the hips, allowing Dasun Shanaka to nudge it away toward square leg for a comfortable run.
11.4: Saim Ayub tosses it wide outside off, Lahiru Udara throws the kitchen sink at it down the pitch, and the bowler reacts sharply to intercept the tracer bullet.
11.5: Saim Ayub drops it slow and wide, and Lahiru Udara stretches out to slap it firmly to sweeper cover, sealing a magnificent half-century off just 32 deliveries.
11.6: Saim Ayub tosses it up to the stumps and Dasun Shanaka stays firmly anchored in his crease to block it away.
12.1: Abrar Ahmed drops it into the pads, and Lahiru Udara crouches low, sweeping it cleanly behind square for four.
12.2: Abrar Ahmed strays very fine, allowing Lahiru Udara to collect three runs.
12.3: Abrar Ahmed probes that disciplined good length directly into the stumps, meeting a dead-bat defensive push from Dasun Shanaka.
12.4: Abrar Ahmed pushes it flat into middle and leg, kept out solidly by Dasun Shanaka toward midwicket.
12.5: Abrar Ahmed serves a good length delivery on off, tapped firmly by Dasun Shanaka from the crease into the off-side for a sharp single.
12.6: Lahiru Udara dances away to the leg-side against Abrar Ahmed, disrupting the spinner's length and launching the ball away to the boundary.
13.1: Shadab Khan tosses it up and Dasun Shanaka works it firmly through the mid-wicket region to rotate the strike with a single.
13.2: Shadab Khan drops it into the pitch, and Lahiru Udara works it away smoothly into the deep square leg region for a single.
13.3: Shadab Khan delivers back, Shanaka swiftly cuts it away, and point hurls across the turf to brilliantly restrict the damage to a single.
13.4: Dot ball from Shadab Khan to Lahiru Udara.
13.5: Shadab Khan drops it slightly back and Lahiru Udara swats it flat and hard just past the bowler's left hand to collect a single.
13.6: Shadab Khan drops it short, Dasun Shanaka unleashes a flat pull, and the deep midwicket fielder's desperate aerial relay ends in agony as his boot kisses the cushion.
14.1: Razaullah watches in disbelief as Lahiru Udara connects cleanly and sends the delivery sailing all the way for a maximum.
14.2: Razaullah unleashes a venomous short delivery that leaps viciously past Lahiru Udara's attempted ramp and sails over the scrambling keeper to race away for four byes.
14.3: Razaullah digs it into the surface again, drawing a hurried slash from Lahiru Udara that catches a thick edge and flies down to third man for a single.
14.4: Razaullah whips it through at searing pace, skidding short of a length outside the channel and completely eluding the keeper for a bye.
14.5: Razaullah dials up the pace, hammering a sharp delivery into the surface outside off that Lahiru Udara wisely decides to leave alone.
14.6: Lahiru Udara opens the face with supreme confidence, guiding Razaullah away behind point to race across the turf for four.
15.1: Shadab Khan drops it short and wide, allowing Dasun Shanaka to steer a single briskly into the cover region, pushing the partnership forward.
15.2: Shadab Khan loops it in for the reverse-sweep attempt from Lahiru Udara, missing the ball entirely before Pakistan squander a review on an impact well outside off stump.
15.3: Shadab Khan drops it short, allowing Lahiru Udara to pull it firmly away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
15.4: Shadab Khan tosses it up and Dasun Shanaka launches it majestically all the way over long-on for a maximum.
15.5: Shadab Khan loops it up, Dasun Shanaka swings hard, but Fakhar Zaman judges it to perfection in the deep to snap up the catch and end an 18-run cameo.

15.6: Shadab Khan drops it short, Dunith Wellalage rocks back to punch off the back foot through midwicket, and Shadab sprints furiously across the turf himself to hunt it down and restrict them to a single.
16.1: Naseem Shah floats the slower length delivery across off, allowing Dunith Wellalage to open the blade and guide it safely down to third man for a single.
16.2: Naseem Shah bowls a slower, short‑outside‑off cutter to Lahiru Udara, who pulls it down to deep square‑leg for a single.
16.3: Wide from Naseem Shah to Dunith Wellalage, 5 runs in all.
16.3: Naseem Shah curls one away past the edge as Dunith Wellalage slashes fiercely into empty air.
16.4: Naseem Shah pulls back the pace, leaving Dunith Wellalage swinging into absolute nothingness after an ambitious shuffle.
16.5: Naseem Shah fires it in, Dunith Wellalage guides it square of the wicket, and they scamper through for a single.
16.6: Naseem Shah digs it in short and takes the pace off outside off, drawing a mistimed cut from Lahiru Udara that trickles away to third man for a single.
17.1: Abrar Ahmed probes against the turn, inducing a high slice from Lahiru Udara that sails agonizingly over the scrambling bowler's outstretched retreat.
17.2: Abrar loops it onto the pads of Lahiru Udara, who fans the ball away into the leg side to hustle back for a second run.
17.3: Abrar Ahmed kills the pace on a length outside off, leaving Wellalage to angle the face and guide a single down to short third.
17.4: Abrar Ahmed pitches it short, and Lahiru Udara exploits the inward-strutting circle with a delicate carve past short fine leg for four.
17.5: Abrar Ahmed pushes through another delivery, turned smartly by Udara into the deep square leg region for a couple of runs.
17.6: Abrar Ahmed serves it full in the slot, punched forcefully straight back where Abrar drops low to intercept with his right hand and deny the run.
18.1: Naseem Shah unleashes a radar-less delivery that sails past Dunith Wellalage for five wides, marking his third such indiscretion of the innings.
18.1: Naseem Shah delivers to Dunith Wellalage, who cracks a firm cut shot straight to deep backward point for a single.
18.2: Naseem Shah charges in and forces a hurried prod from Lahiru Udara, squeezing it away toward the keeper for a sharp single.
18.3: Naseem Shah strikes with venom, shattering Dunith Wellalage's stumps as the batsman departs for five.
18.4: Naseem Shah lands it back of a length outside off and Theekshana remains in his crease to guide it safely into the off-side for a single.
18.5: Naseem Shah delivers to Lahiru Udara, who guides the ball deliberately down to the third man boundary for four.
18.6: Naseem Shah attacks the stumps with a full delivery, denying Lahiru Udara the elevation he craves and picking out Hasan Nawaz at long-on to end a brilliant 91.
19.1: Razaullah takes his maiden T20I scalp as Maheesh Theekshana mistimes a slower, short delivery straight up into the air for a simple catch back to the bowler.
19.2: Razaullah digs into a slower short delivery angling past off stump, leaving Malinga grasping at air through an early pull before scampering a hurried bye.
19.3: Razaullah targets the ribs with a sharp short ball, catching the splice of Dushmantha Chameera's mistimed pull as it loops away toward long-on for a single.
19.4: Razaullah oversteps the mark, conceding a no-ball as the delivery skims past to yield a bye.
19.4: Razaullah offers width, and Dushmantha Chameera punches it cleanly down the ground, racing away to the long-off boundary.
19.5: Razaullah hunts for the base of the stumps with a searing yorker, squeezing out a single as Dushmantha Chameera scrambles through.

19.6: Razaullah offers a dipping low full toss on off stump, and Eshan Malinga arrives late to the drive, clipping it off the cue to extra cover for a solitary run to bring down the curtain on the innings.
SL post 182, edging just past the usual 179-run par score here at Rawalpindi!
0.1: Nuwan Thushara begins with a sensational delivery, curving into middle before darting away off the seam to leave Sahibzada Farhan entirely fortunate to avoid the edge.
0.2: Nuwan Thushara pulls his length back to test Sahibzada Farhan, who retreats onto the crease and chips the ball toward midwicket.
0.3: Nuwan Thushara delivers short of length outside off, and Sahibzada Farhan steps back to punch wide of mid-off for his opening run.
0.4: Nuwan Thushara targets leg-stump with a back-of-a-length delivery that Fakhar Zaman fails to tuck away, deflecting off the pad toward fine-leg for a leg-bye.
0.5: Nuwan Thushara induces a thick outside edge as Sahibzada Farhan flashes aggressively at a fullish outswinger, fortunate to watch it sail over short third man for four.
0.6: Nuwan Thushara targets a full length just outside off, extracting subtle away movement that leaves Sahibzada Farhan beaten on the outside edge as the batter pokes without conviction.
1.1: Dushmantha Chameera arcs a sharp incoming delivery into the pads, leaving Fakhar Zaman beaten on the flick without an appeal.
1.2: Fakhar Zaman charges down the pitch and completely loses control on a wild heave, thick-edging the length ball safely over the slips for four.
1.3: Dushmantha Chameera drops onto the pads, and Fakhar Zaman strides forward to neatly flick it past the leg-side ring for a couple of runs.
1.4: Dushmantha Chameera delivers, and Fakhar Zaman dispatches it with absolute authority to the deep mid-wicket fence for four.
1.5: Dushmantha Chameera offers width, and Fakhar Zaman instantly punishes the full delivery with a blistering square-drive that races past the despairing dive at backward point for four.
1.6: Chameera digs this in short, Fakhar top-edges the pull high into the night sky, and Arachchige performs a gravity-defying acrobatic rescue at third man to bat it back and save the boundary.
2.1: Sahibzada Farhan does not score off Nuwan Thushara.
2.2: Thushara steams in and delivers to Farhan, who pushes it down the ground toward long-off to scamper back for an effortless couple.
2.3: Nuwan Thushara delivers a full slower-ball off-cutter that Sahibzada Farhan aggressively drives straight down the ground past mid-on for four.
2.4: Sahibzada Farhan does not score off Nuwan Thushara.
2.5: Nuwan Thushara delivers into the arc, and Sahibzada Farhan launches it cleanly over long-off for a maximum.

2.6: Nuwan Thushara gathers himself after a false start, slamming a short slower-ball off-cutter into the off-side which Sahibzada Farhan aggressively pulls toward deep backward square-leg for a single.
PAK have brilliantly swung the match their way, cruising at 28 without loss after 2.4 overs and needing 154 more!
3.1: Eshan Malinga steams in and watches Sahibzada Farhan glance the delivery sharply away toward backward square leg to comfortably hustle back for a second run.
3.2: Eshan Malinga hits the fifth-stump channel with sudden venom, forcing Sahibzada Farhan to flinch as the ball screams past his outside edge into the gloves of a leaping Kusal Mendis.
3.3: Eshan Malinga fires another 140kph thunderbolt full on off, drawing Sahibzada Farhan forward into a tentative push that deflects off the thick outer edge toward deep backward point for a single.
3.4: Fakhar Zaman does not score off Eshan Malinga.
3.5: Dot ball from Eshan Malinga to Fakhar Zaman.
3.6: Eshan Malinga delivers on a shortish length targeting middle and off as Fakhar Zaman clears room to smash a hard cut straight to the fielder stationed at cover-point.
4.1: Dushmantha Chameera serves it up and Sahibzada Farhan launches it cleanly straight down the ground to pick up a boundary.
4.2: Chameera digs this short of a length outside off, and Farhan lunges forward to push it untimedly into the covers for a scampered single.
4.3: Chameera serves it up full, and Fakhar Zaman launches it straight down the ground with immense power for a boundary.
4.4: Chameera rolls his fingers over the ball on a good length into the leg-stump, and Zaman presses forward to steer it away into the deep backward square-leg region for a single.
4.5: Farhan creates room and carves Chameera into the off-side grass, lacking his usual crispness of timing but scampering back for a scrambling second run at deep backward point.
4.6: Chameera offers width on a length, and Sahibzada Farhan leans forward to dispatch the drive with authority through the cover region for four.
5.1: Eshan Malinga strikes early as Fakhar Zaman edges it through to Lahiru Udara, departing after a brisk twenty-one decorated with four boundaries.
5.2: Eshan Malinga fires this short of a length on off, and Maaz Sadaqat camps on the back foot to steer it defensively straight to backward point with no width afforded.
5.3: Eshan Malinga steams in, but Maaz Sadaqat dismisses him with utter disdain, launching a phenomenal no-look maximum that underscores his blistering CPL century-scoring form.
5.4: Eshan Malinga slides a full delivery onto the off stump, meeting Maaz Sadaqat's forward defensive prod straight into the turf at backward point.
5.5: Eshan Malinga floats a length ball on middle, and Maaz Sadaqat reads the slower off-cutter instantly, lifting it majestically over the deep square-leg ropes.
5.6: Eshan Malinga delivers into the surface, and Maaz Sadaqat guides it sharply away to the deep backward point boundary.
6.1: Theekshana loops it up to Sahibzada Farhan, who drives firmly out to long-on and scampers back for a comfortable couple.
6.2: Dot ball from Maheesh Theekshana to Sahibzada Farhan.
6.3: Maheesh Theekshana spears this in on a length, catching the thick outer half of Sahibzada Farhan's bat as he pushes forward toward cover for a dot.
6.4: Maheesh Theekshana tosses this full outside off, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to stride forward and stroke it cleanly down to long-off for a single.
6.5: Maheesh Theekshana keeps it tidy, drawing a gentle push toward mid-off as a single is quietly pinched.

6.6: Maheesh Theekshana drills a searing yorker into the base of the stumps with a sharp, late inward drift, forcing Sahibzada Farhan to hurriedly dig it away toward deep backward square-leg for a single.
7.1: Dasun Shanaka drops it into the arc and Sahibzada Farhan pounces, carving the ball away through the extra-cover region for a crisp boundary.
7.2: Dasun Shanaka probes down leg with a sharp nipper as Sahibzada Farhan misses the flick, saved only by Kusal Mendis diving hard to his left to parry a certain boundary and concede a bye.

7.3: Dasun Shanaka attacks from around the wicket with a clever pace-off delivery on a good length, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to drop back and comfortably ease it away into the deep mid-wicket pocket for a single.
7.4: No run for Sahibzada Farhan off Dasun Shanaka.
7.5: Shanaka delivers on a good length outside the off stump, prompting Sahibzada Farhan onto the back foot to punch it fiercely toward the sweeper cover fielder for a single.
7.6: Dot ball from Dasun Shanaka to Maaz Sadaqat.
8.1: Theekshana lands this one on a good length outside off, and Farhan retreats to the back foot to steer it straight back down the pitch.
8.2: Theekshana darts a flat, good-length delivery outside off, and Sahibzada Farhan retreats onto the back foot, punching a single smoothly toward long-off.
8.3: Theekshana strays, and Maaz Sadaqat swiftly guides it away down to the fine leg boundary for four.
8.4: Maheesh Theekshana loops this full delivery into off stump, inviting Maaz Sadaqat forward to stroke it down towards long-off for a single.
8.5: No run for Sahibzada Farhan off Maheesh Theekshana.
8.6: Maheesh Theekshana drops it into the arc and Sahibzada Farhan ruthlessly launches it sailing all the way over deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
9.1: Dasun Shanaka streams in and delivers to Maaz Sadaqat, who sweeps it away firmly into the depths of square leg to comfortably scamper back for a scampered couple of runs.
9.2: Dasun Shanaka drops short, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to swivel and deposit it over backward square-leg for four.
9.3: Dasun Shanaka drops an off-cutter into the surface just short of a length, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to step back onto his back foot and punch it cleanly toward long-off for a single.
9.4: Shanaka rolls his fingers over a full off-cutter, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to step forward and nudge it toward deep mid-wicket for a single.

9.5: Shanaka rolls his fingers over the ball with a deceptive leg-cutter, full and wide of off, inviting the drive from Maaz Sadaqat who leans forward but sends it straight down the throat of the extra-cover fielder patrolling the edge of the ring.
9.6: Dasun Shanaka bowls a wide to Maaz Sadaqat.
9.6: Dasun Shanaka tosses it up, Maaz Sadaqat drives it firmly down to long-off and jogs through for a single.
10.1: Dot ball from Dunith Wellalage to Maaz Sadaqat.
10.2: Dunith Wellalage floats it up, and Maaz Sadaqat charges down the track to dispatch the delivery cleanly over long-on for a maximum.
10.3: Dunith Wellalage spears a flat length into the leg-stump, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to retreat onto the back foot and hustle back for a second run after pulling into the gap.
10.4: Dunith Wellalage fires in a flat ninety kph delivery on a good length, and Maaz Sadaqat camps back to carve a mistimed single toward long-off.
10.5: Dunith Wellalage darts another one through, and Sahibzada Farhan collects a solitary run down to long-on.
10.6: Dunith Wellalage darts this flat delivery through, Maaz Sadaqat camps back and hammers the pull hard toward deep mid-wicket for a single.
11.1: Eshan Malinga drops the slower off-cutter right up to Maaz Sadaqat, who drives aerially as Shanaka charges in with a desperate forward dive at cover only to watch it land safely.
11.2: Eshan Malinga delivers full and straight into the channel, allowing Sahibzada Farhan to punch a sharp square drive firmly down to the deep point boundary fielder for a single.
11.3: Eshan Malinga digs it in short with a change of pace, and Maaz Sadaqat flashes hard at the delivery outside off only to find absolute emptiness.
11.4: Eshan Malinga steams in, and Maaz Sadaqat whips it away with supreme authority, finding the boundary behind square leg.
11.5: Eshan Malinga fires it full and zippy outside off, drawing a desperate drive from Maaz Sadaqat that sails harmlessly over the timber.
11.6: Eshan Malinga takes pace off with a full cutter outside off, allowing Maaz Sadaqat to stride forward and punch it square into the off-side for a single.
12.1: Dunith Wellalage keeps it flat and outside off on a good length, inviting Maaz Sadaqat onto the back foot to drill a fierce drive straight to extra-cover on the rim.
12.2: Dunith Wellalage bowls a wide to Maaz Sadaqat.
12.2: Dunith Wellalage floats it up on a good length outside off, and Maaz Sadaqat springs back to force a pull into the vast spaces of deep mid-wicket for a pair of runs.
12.3: Dunith Wellalage keeps testing the batter, drawing a soft push from Maaz Sadaqat out toward the deep mid-wicket region for a single.

12.4: Dunith Wellalage pushes it through on a flat good length outside off, prompting a ferocious blow from Sahibzada Farhan that breaks through Arachchige's desperate slide at sweeper cover to race away for four.
12.5: Dot ball from Dunith Wellalage to Sahibzada Farhan.
12.6: Dunith Wellalage loops it through the air, and Sahibzada Farhan pushes it firmly down to long-on for a single.
13.1: Maheesh Theekshana drops it on a length, and Sahibzada Farhan crouches low to launch a towering eighty-one-metre slog sweep high over deep midwicket.
13.2: Maheesh Theekshana fires it in again, but Sahibzada Farhan sweeps it firmly away toward deep square leg for four runs.
13.3: Maheesh Theekshana drifts one through the air, and Sahibzada Farhan leans into the stroke, carving it cleanly away to the extra cover boundary.
13.4: Maheesh Theekshana fires a full one into off where Sahibzada Farhan pushes forward, prompting Theekshana into a sharp left-handed dive to deflect the ball toward cover for a run.
13.5: Maheesh Theekshana strikes decisively to trap Maaz Sadaqat lbw, ending a dashing fifty of 50 runs from 29 deliveries featuring four fours and three sixes.
13.6: Maheesh Theekshana fires it in, and Hasan Nawaz works it away to deep square leg to rotate the strike.
14.1: Dushmantha Chameera delivers the breakthrough, inducing the edge from Hasan Nawaz that Kusal Mendis gratefully accepts behind the stumps to notch up Chameera's landmark hundredth wicket.
14.2: Dushmantha Chameera drops it short, allowing Saim Ayub to punch it cleanly into the square on the off side for a comfortable pair.

14.3: Dushmantha Chameera offers width outside off and Saim Ayub stretches to carve it over backward point, leaving Mishara helpless in a desperate dive to his right at sweeper cover as the ball races away to the fence.
14.4: Chameera targets the channel outside off, and Ayub retreats swiftly, angling the bat just enough to squeeze a single down toward third man.
14.5: Dushmantha Chameera digs it in short at 137kph, hurrying Sahibzada Farhan with steep bounce as the attempted pull misses the midriff entirely before ricocheting away for a leg bye.
14.6: Dushmantha Chameera delivers to Saim Ayub, who guides the ball away toward deep backward point to pick up a single.
15.1: Maheesh Theekshana unleashes a mystery delivery that completely outflanks Saim Ayub, crashing straight into the stumps to dismantle his eight-run knock.
15.2: Theekshana lands the off-break on a good length targeting leg-stump, and Nafay tickles it away down to fine-leg for a single.
15.3: Dot ball from Maheesh Theekshana to Sahibzada Farhan.

15.4: Maheesh Theekshana drops it short outside off, Sahibzada Farhan pounces on the back foot with a ferocious pull, but Shanaka flings himself to his left at extra-cover to palm it away and salvage a crucial boundary-saving single.
15.5: Theekshana floats it full on off stump, Nafay creates space to drive straight back, only to watch the bowler throw himself low to the left and cut off the stroke.
15.6: Maheesh Theekshana darts this flat and good length just outside off, and Khawaja Nafay steps back onto the crease to drive it firmly down to long-on for a single.
16.1: Wellalage serves it outside off on a length, and Khawaja Nafay steps back to carve it through the region between backward point and deep point for a brace.
16.2: Wellalage fires a flat delivery on a good length around off, prompting Khawaja Nafay onto the back foot to maneuver it past mid-wicket for a single.
16.3: Wellalage drops it on a good length outside off, and Sahibzada Farhan retreats to carve it wide of sweeper cover, scampering through industriously for a hustled brace.
16.4: Wellalage angles this flat good length delivery wide of the crease, inviting Sahibzada Farhan onto the back foot to drill a firm push straight into extra-cover.
16.5: Dot ball from Dunith Wellalage to Sahibzada Farhan.
16.6: Dunith Wellalage floats it up full outside off, and Sahibzada Farhan marches down the pitch before dragging his heavy heave into the deep mid-wicket turf for a single.

17.1: Thushara rolls his fingers across the seam with a deceptive slower-ball off-cutter, but Farhan reads the length instantly, holding his shape before flat-batting the short delivery high and wide over extra-cover to race away for four.
17.2: Dot ball from Nuwan Thushara to Sahibzada Farhan.
17.3: Nuwan Thushara drifts one into Sahibzada Farhan, who dispatches it firmly toward the deep square leg boundary for four runs.
17.4: Nuwan Thushara leans into his delivery stride, sending down a length ball that Sahibzada Farhan ruthlessly dispatches over deep extra cover for a maximum.
17.5: Nuwan Thushara strikes a crucial blow as Sahibzada Farhan picks out Sahan Arachchige in the deep, departing for a brilliant 89.
17.6: Nuwan Thushara digs this one in short, whizzing past Shadab Khan's desperate, flailing hook into the keeper's gloves for a dot ball.
18.1: Eshan Malinga serves up a low full-toss outside off, and Khawaja Nafay steps forward, presenting the full blade to drive wide of mid-off for a sharp single.
18.2: Eshan Malinga strikes in the death as Shadab Khan holes out, offering a simple catch to Nuwan Thushara to walk back for a duck.
18.3: Eshan Malinga fires in a low full-toss on middle, angling back slightly, and Mohammad Imran Randhawa steps forward to dead-bat it straight down the pitch.
18.4: Eshan Malinga extracts alarming reverse-swing as a sharp back-of-a-length delivery darts inward to rap Mohammad Imran Randhawa on the midriff, allowing the batters to scramble a hasty leg bye.

18.5: Eshan Malinga rolls his fingers across a slower length delivery outside off, and Khawaja Nafay steps forward to launch it majestically over long-on for a monumental six that seals victory for Pakistan.

preview.text: Pakistan and Sri Lanka meet for their thirty-first T20 match at Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium, where Pakistan has won eighteen of the thirty previous encounters. Sri Lanka won the toss and chose to bat first in a game where the usual first-innings score in the forty-nine recorded T20 matches at the venue is 179. The forecast for the next 8 hours indicates up to a 28 per cent chance of rain and about 23 degrees.

summary.text: In the 49 recorded T20 matches at Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium, the usual first-innings score is 179. Pakistan recently won by 4 wkts after SL posted 182-8, featuring 91 off 55 balls from top scorer Lahiru Udara (wk) and 3 for 36 from best bowler Naseem Shah. PAK replied with 187-6, led by top scorer Sahibzada Farhan (c) with 89 off 53 balls against best bowler Eshan Malinga, who took 2 for 33.
